rules: every version forecasts the same eligible games at the same T-60 information cutoff from the same L1 snapshot
each version writes its own immutable forecast package per game; a locked package is never rewritten; corrections are new package versions
a model version never changes after its card is written; learning from prospective outcomes creates a new version
no version's prospective results alter another version during the evaluation period
comparisons use only games every compared version forecast, per target and population, on the cumulative tables
attribution is reported stepwise: v0.2 - v0.1 = season awareness; v0.3 - v0.2 = availability; v0.4 - v0.3 = rotation / minutes + opportunity redistribution; never only the v0.4 score
PLANNED versions are refused by the executor until their card is FROZEN with hashes and a pinned commit

versions.lane: S0 (also run by X1 alongside every challenger)
versions.lineage: P1 ladder rung L2 = hoopslab.models.baselines.PlayerMean(half_life=5.0), mode A
versions.changes: none; must never be modified (no season reset, no injury information, no minutes model, no recalibration, h = 5, forecast population unchanged)
inputs: ELIGIBLE (4 states, derived one way from an L1 snapshot by hoopslab.pregame.contract.to_eligible_v01)

versions.changes: historical weighting only: weight = recency x season-transition x context-similarity with the grid point frozen by R1; same targets, pmf construction, dispersion fit, league fallback, cutoff
must_not_contain: tonight's availability beyond the ELIGIBLE states the baseline also receives
requires: research_season/01_carryover_spec.md frozen by a changelog row
card with implementation hash and pinned commit

versions.changes: adds tonight's player availability and roster status from the L1 snapshot (availability, roster, lineup, team_absences tables): who is eligible and which teammates are absent; the historical weighting is v0.2's
inputs: L1 snapshot: availability, roster, lineup, team_absences
requires: a frozen rule for how absent teammates enter (fixed before any prospective forecast)

versions.changes: season awareness + availability + rotation / minutes redistribution + opportunity redistribution; decomposed: current roster -> availability -> start / bench / role -> minutes distribution -> usage / FGA / opportunity distribution -> per-minute production -> PTS / REB / AST / FG3M / TOV / PRA distributions
requires: R2 report with COMPONENTS FROZEN FOR v0.4: YES
